column1: # The attestation MODULE census: every source file the attestation
# libraries and their mutation tooling are made of, recorded by path.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, stated plainly because the reason is a defect
# this repository actually shipped. A commit removed nine source files
# -- two library modules, a verifier module, a test harness, three
# gates and two mutation tools -- and NOTHING went red. Every structural
# check in the suite counts refusal sites, test cases and pinned
# fixtures; the derived artifacts (the generated test-edge table, the
# static case-count baseline, the source inventory) are REGENERATED from
# a directory scan, so a deleted gate does not contradict them, it
# simply stops appearing in them. A smaller tree is a consistent tree.
# So this is a census over the CODE, not over the fixtures. Its sibling
# BYTES; this one records every file carrying the attestation libraries'
# own LOGIC. The gate beside it, `t_attestation_module_census.nim`,
# requires each recorded path to be present and non-empty, requires the
# record to match a directory scan in BOTH directions, and requires the
# recorded umbrella wiring to be what the umbrella actually does.
#   path       the file, relative to the repository root
#              `library`  -- a submodule of one of those libraries
#              nothing else in the tree references, and which therefore
#              has no other reason to stay
#              `gate`     -- a Nim source under tests/integration whose
#              text names an attestation library. Three of these went
#              with the nine files above, and the derived artifacts
#              could not see it: they are regenerated from a directory
#              scan, so three fewer gates is three fewer rows and no
#   umbrella   for `library` rows only: `exported` if the umbrella
#              imports AND re-exports this module, `standalone` if it
#              deliberately does neither. Nine modules are standalone on
#              purpose -- a key-encapsulation primitive, a socket client,
#              a lease holder and the quote/collateral readers that only
#              their own callers want -- and the gate asserts the
#              recorded value against the umbrella's own text in both
#              directions, so a module silently unwired from its library
#              is red even while the file is still there. That is the
#              other half of what the commit above did.
#   summary    the module's own first documentation line, trimmed. Prose
#              only; nothing is asserted about it.
# Adding a module to either library, or a tool to the mutation
# directory, turns the gate red until a row is added here. That is the
# point: a hand-kept list that stops tracking what it enumerates is the
# failure this file is a response to, so the list is itself a check. The
# gate also pins the per-directory row COUNTS as literal numbers, so
# deleting a file and its row together is not a quiet operation either.
